name: three-steps-for-not-dying
why: Opens on "The Three-Step Recipe for Not Dying" as YOU ticks breathe, keep breathing, try not to die in a helmet, and the pull-back finds him under a 604-to-1 tower of missiles whose top one lands on him; he ticks the box anyway and a missile waves out of the Earth.

name: option-b
why: Opens on the weapons factory kissing a spreadsheet; column A's customers are skeletons with blank feedback slips, column B's bury it in five stars, and it picks B for the shareholders, not the halo, and answers the quarterly call with dollar-sign eyes.

name: lure-a-dog-with-a-steak
why: Opens on a politician who is one cell with one drive, head-down in the weapons factory's garbage can until YOU walks past with a steak of 280 million votes, and ends with the insurance company's lobbyists sitting up to beg at YOU the mailman.
